periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented diagonally, slanting downwards and outwards from the medial to the lateral margins.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal aspect ratio greater than 1:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward expansion resulting in a teardrop-shaped profile where the mass is concentrated at the lower pole.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Posterior edge displays a broad, shallow U-shaped curvature across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band maintains a relatively uniform thickness, occupying approximately 25-30% of the visible dorsal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant lateral separation with a medial gap approximately equal to the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, convex semi-circular curvature at the superior boundary.
